<div id="45309a6d29fb3211af4b971d6748d977" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731639356000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">90+3</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Pulisic's free kick is a poor one and easily cleared, but we're into the final minute of the four now. </p><p>Can Jamaica muster a late chance?</p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:55:56-05:00">Posted at: 21:55 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="89badad9f45c3996a6176d3c744cb9d1" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731639323000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">90+2</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p><strong>Isaac Hayden hacks down Malik Tillman</strong> on the edge of the Jamaica box. </p><p>A good crossing position for Pulisic and a few more seconds wasted for the US. Steve McClaren throws a water bottle in frustration. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:55:23-05:00">Posted at: 21:55 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="b7d5e71b133b3e8a904bec54ef6bbd2c" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731639263000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">90+1</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p><strong>Good hold-up play from Vazquez</strong> to bring the ball down and find Robinson, overlapping on the left. The US knock the ball in search of a shooting angle but the move fizzles out. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:54:23-05:00">Posted at: 21:54 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="b757a812465e3c3092dc41f09cef25c2" data-les-card="start-end" data-sort-time="1731639162000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-i-ct"><i class="ev-i ev-i-tmp"></i></div><div class="ev-timer">90</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>We're going to have another <strong>four minutes of added time</strong> in Kingston. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:52:42-05:00">Posted at: 21:52 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="1ba444bf6a8b3cd9805c1879e5152b39" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731639144000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">89</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Into the final minutes now, USMNT just need to hold on to ensure that Pochettino's first competitive game ends in victory. </p><p>With the one-man advantage the US are looking much more composed now, able to knock the ball around fairly calmly in the midfield. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:52:24-05:00">Posted at: 21:52 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="77010b50d00a3669a458c3e370e8ac64" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731639050000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">88</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Difficult to see exactly what that Holgate second yellow was for. He was involved in a bit of pushing with Brandon Vasquez but there was nothing too obvious. </p><p>Real lack of composure from the former Everton defender. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:50:50-05:00">Posted at: 21:50 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="441671ce43b33ab9a7c635f861f66590" data-les-card="red-card" data-sort-time="1731638955000" class="ev-unit ev-highlight"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-i-ct"><i class="ev-i ev-i-rcard"></i></div><div class="ev-timer">87</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p class="ev-title">Mason Holgate sent off!</p><p>The Jamaica defender is shown a second yellow card and he's off! Huge moment in this game, just as the hosts were really starting to turn the screw. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:49:15-05:00">Posted at: 21:49 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="0a4dd395272b3cff81126b9304fb8d49" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731638715000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">82</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>A rare break forward for the US finds<strong> Pulisic streaking away down the left.</strong> He tries to find Vazquez in the middle but the pass is a little overhit and the big striker can't find an angle for the shot.</p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:45:15-05:00">Posted at: 21:45 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="36a590079c0d35cfacf8dcac5fc56d89" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731638633000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">81</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Can Jamaica muster one more clear-cut chance in the final ten minutes? They've really taken the game to the US in the last 20 minutes but haven't managed to generate many real openings. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:43:53-05:00">Posted at: 21:43 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="34c727ecf3253d398c8e75a41aa1c713" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731638595000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">80</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p><strong>Strong run from Isaac Hayden</strong> down the left flank. He gets past Scally but stumbles as he enters the box. </p><p>The Jamaican wideman wants a penalty but the referee isn't convinced. It would have been very soft. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:43:15-05:00">Posted at: 21:43 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>

Weston McKennie and Ricardo Pepi come off. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:33:56-05:00">Posted at: 21:33 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="4118928976b73ad2b00072d86bf755aa" data-les-card="yellow-card" data-sort-time="1731637915000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-i-ct"><i class="ev-i ev-i-ycard"></i></div><div class="ev-timer">69</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p class="ev-title">Antonee Robinson, Leon Bailey</p><p>Both players go into the book for their roles in that little spat. In fairness to Robinson, it looked like Bailey may have started it. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:31:55-05:00">Posted at: 21:31 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="04408b82639d3963a70633ee09038579" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731637866000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">67</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Tempers flare again as<strong> Pulisic is the subject of another tough challenge from a Jamaican defender.</strong> Robinson wasted no time to charge in and defend his teammate, grabbing Leon Bailey by the jersey. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:31:06-05:00">Posted at: 21:31 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="c3205dbf46993856b80d502f4ca63eee" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731637795000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">66</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Jamaica come close again! This time it's an in-swinging corner kick that nearly catches out Turner at the near post. </p><p><strong>The hosts are insisting that the ball cross the line</strong>, but the referee says no. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:29:55-05:00">Posted at: 21:29 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="af1da6c9d61f3b37aff78ba8a87b5ed5" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731637747000" class="ev-unit ev-highlight"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">65</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p class="ev-title">So close for Jamaica!</p><p>The free kick is played shorted and Jamaica work it to <strong>Cephas </strong>on the right. He fires a low cross across the six-yard box but Musah does brilliantly to clear the danger at the back post. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:29:07-05:00">Posted at: 21:29 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="de563a3b27d4346aa669988375bd9a41" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731637683000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">64</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Damion Lowe does brilliantly to dispossess Pepi and then charge through the middle. He beats three US midfielders before eventually being hauled down. </p><p><strong>Free kick to Jamaica,</strong> about 40 yards from goal. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:28:03-05:00">Posted at: 21:28 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="f95c1dedddd4358784fd782ac37355e9" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731637501000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">62</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>The referee takes a few moments to calm things down. He gives special attention to <strong>Pulisic, who seems particularly unhappy</strong>. In fairness, it did look like Lowe gave him a bit of a barge for no reason. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:25:01-05:00">Posted at: 21:25 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="1312f0cf2edd396993822260d2b44a25" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731637442000" class="ev-unit ev-highlight"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">61</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p class="ev-title">It's heating up!</p><p>Tensions starting to fray after a coming together in the midfielder between Pulisic and Lowe. The USMNT star didn't appreciate that and quickly makes it known. </p><p>Within seconds, about 15 players are squaring up on the halfway line. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:24:02-05:00">Posted at: 21:24 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="6dd3ec9cecf13d08bd21cc81e91ab6f9" data-les-card="substitution" data-sort-time="1731637223000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-i-ct"><i class="ev-i ev-i-subs"></i></div><div class="ev-timer">58</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Another change for the hosts, with Kasey Palmer replaced by <strong>Tyreek Magee</strong>. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:20:23-05:00">Posted at: 21:20 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="581b01253fdd376cbaf48700bfc4e078" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731637134000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">56</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p><strong>More good work from Cephas </strong>on the left but he choose the wrong option at the end, firing wide of the target rather than looking for a teammate in the middle. </p><p>Nevertheless, he's giving Joe Scally plenty to think about. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:18:54-05:00">Posted at: 21:18 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="40ea26a4fadc36219bf3b2025b254728" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731637082000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">55</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>The United States look much more assured in the build-up than they have at pretty much any point in the past year. R<strong>eem's on-ball quality is really helping,</strong> forcing Jamaica to work very hard to regain possession. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:18:02-05:00">Posted at: 21:18 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="1569d82b317036f69aed5ad54803f864" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731636974000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">53</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Huge groans from the home crowd as Kasey Palmer is penalised on the halfway line. He did well to get his body in front of Tessman there, a little unlucky with the foul call. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:16:14-05:00">Posted at: 21:16 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="a960a63e8be53ed1974dfeb112aae053" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731636862000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">51</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Good work from <strong>Renaldo Cephas </strong>for Jamaica, cutting inside off the left and letting fly with a right-footed effort. They haven't blown Jamaica away but the US do look to have a more considered style of play in the first half. </p><p>The visitors have built through the lines well and look determined to get their countless central midfielders on the ball. Just as crucially, they're working well off the ball too. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T21:01:51-05:00">Posted at: 21:01 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>

<div id="06360a1c2f293d6eb398b2ce7139de44" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731635383000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">45+3</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Clash in the midfield between McKennie and Latibeaudiere. </p><p>Looks like McKennie came off worse and USMNT win the free kick. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T20:49:43-05:00">Posted at: 20:49 EST 14/11/2024  and modified at 20:50 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="2d7b6716cb1f3c48929b580b3c33dfe4" data-les-card="start-end" data-sort-time="1731635208000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-i-ct"><i class="ev-i ev-i-tmp"></i></div><div class="ev-timer">45</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>We're going to have <strong>four minutes of added time </strong>at the end of the first half. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T20:46:48-05:00">Posted at: 20:46 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="dd0f5e266e213dbfa51f6fcae36fa629" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731635164000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">43</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Final spell of possession from Jamaica to end the half. The United States have done a good job of preventing the hosts from progressing so far but Amarii Bell wriggles free of Pepi and tries to get his team up the pitch. </p><p>It's worked out to Leon Bailey but he can't make anything of the opening. <strong>Goal kick to USMNT. </strong></p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T20:46:04-05:00">Posted at: 20:46 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="cd8cf7160ec23c4daf3ece9420a98a34" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731634975000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">41</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Jamaica go long again but <strong>McKenzie does well to win the aerial duel </strong>and nod the ball down to Pulisic. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T20:42:55-05:00">Posted at: 20:42 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="de68d807b0513e48ae2cb5ab081efeea" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731634947000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">40</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p><strong>USMNT trying to restore a bit of control </strong>as the first half draws to a close. </p><p>They're still been put under real pressure form the Jamaica frontline, who are undoubtedly difficult to play through. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T20:42:27-05:00">Posted at: 20:42 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="332b9c3156b03a7ba9ad5a43151939a0" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731634744000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">37</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Bit more ambition shown by Jamaica in the last few minutes and the home crowd responds by pumping up the noise level of the horns and drums. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T20:39:04-05:00">Posted at: 20:39 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="6b55872aa5a23002b261adea0cb98f17" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731634683000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">36</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p><strong>Good work from Laqtibeaudiere</strong> in the middle for Jamaica, breaking up play and passing forward to Bailey. He tries to find a teammate in the box but the pass is loose and USMNT win it back. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T20:38:03-05:00">Posted at: 20:38 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="c703c76a54b23747bfbc9a47210b845a" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731634567000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">34</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>Jamaica play a long ball forward towards Nicholson. He's in behind the US backline but <strong>Turner comes out well to boot the ball clear. </strong></p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T20:36:07-05:00">Posted at: 20:36 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="13f33cebc3273965a5c579550519522a" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731634520000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">33</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>The quality of the surface in Kingston is really causing problems for both teams as they try to build up in the middle. There are large divots right across the field and it's cutting up with every tackle and tumble. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T20:35:20-05:00">Posted at: 20:35 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
<div id="2344f18a6afc36ffa7ff038c799b2996" data-les-card="default" data-sort-time="1731634413000" class="ev-unit"><div class="ev-side"><div class="ev-timer">31</div></div><div class="ev-main"><div class="ev-text"><p>The US are playing in a hybrid system with Reem, McKenzie and Scally functioning as a back three while building up from the back. This is allowing Robinson to push much higher on the left, and Pulisic to drift inside to influence the game in central areas. </p><p>It's working well so far. </p></div><div class="ev-au"><span class="ev-au-name">William Gittins</span><span class="ev-au-date"><time datetime="2024-11-14T20:33:33-05:00">Posted at: 20:33 EST 14/11/2024 </time></span></div></div></div>
